title: Night walk: the snail-eating glow
storyboard: Film: naturalist on a night walk with a red-filtered torch, finding a glowing firefly larva; hands only
caption:
The cutest glow on our night walk belongs to a snail hunter.

Firefly light is made when enzymes act on molecules called luciferins, which react with oxygen and ATP.
